general.name: Apple Mosswell
general.headline: Operations & Systems Specialist
about: I build the digital backbone that keeps operations clean, fast, and organized. Instead of chasing quick fixes, I dig into the backend logic, clean up messy databases, and turn chaotic workflows into automated systems that actually work.

When I'm not untangling database architecture, I’m usually teaching myself coding, building personal projects, or testing new Android roots. I love the backend of systems and owning all aspects of what technology can do for us.

experiences.title: Operations & Systems Specialist
experiences.description: I managed the backend infrastructure for 35+ national location rollouts annually while auditing internal workflows to eliminate operational bottlenecks. By rebuilding company SOPs from scratch and transforming an unorganized Salesforce instance with automated tracking and auto-calculation logic, I consolidated fractured communication channels and modernized hundreds of legacy accounts. As the internal technical point person, I owned system permissions, managed end-to-end employee onboarding, and served as the primary troubleshooter for cross-functional roadblocks to keep the daily operation running smoothly.

experiences.title: Operations Lead
experiences.description: I managed nightly dispatch logistics for a 15-driver fleet, ensuring full compliance with strict state-mandated delivery regulations. Alongside routing operations, I reconciled daily cash logs and resolved high-volume customer and field service escalations under tight operational windows.

experiences.title: Unit Lead & Caregiver
experiences.description: I directed specialized memory and Alzheimer's care for a 28-resident unit, earning a promotion to Unit Lead within weeks of hiring. Alongside managing daily resident health and safety metrics, I built and led training programs for incoming care staff to ensure compliance and high-quality care standards across the unit.

education.subject: Salesforce Administration Cert
education.description: Expanding advanced technical capabilities, database hygiene, and automated workflow architecture through self-directed platform training.

education.subject: Systems Security
education.description: Studying core security principles, risk management, and threat mitigation to deepen backend systems infrastructure security knowledge.

education.subject: Process Optimization
education.description: Mastering the formal corporate frameworks and methodology for process optimization and efficiency standards that I already practice and apply in live operations.

volunteering.description: Supported therapeutic horseback riding programs by coordinating weekly session logistics and assisting individuals with special needs to ensure a safe, structured environment.
Conducted direct street outreach in remote camp areas to provide food, toiletries, basic medical aid, clothing, and critical community resources to unhoused individuals.
